chronology.contamination_note: 2018-2023 broad-market outcomes are consumed development evidence; post-2023 broad-market security outcomes remain unread. Only calendar/schema metadata may be inspected before Stage C.
chronology.embargo: also remove the final signal session immediately before each prediction block even when its exit is earlier; no training sample may cross the overnight boundary into prediction time
chronology.purge: for every prediction block, remove every training sample whose actual legal exit date is on or after the first prediction date

execution_contract.corporate_actions: reuse ASHARE-CA-REPLAY-003 known_at/effective_date rules; block known new risk, carry exact supported cash-only actions, require pre-effective risk exit for share/rights events, and fail closed on unresolved terms
execution_contract.cost_interpretation: canonical all-in repository convention including applicable commission/tax/slippage allowance
execution_contract.entry_interpretation: one-minute VWAP of the bar ending 14:56, representing an order released just after 14:55; no earlier or later entry clock is compared
execution_contract.entry_price: raw unadjusted amount/volume of the 14:56 bar
execution_contract.exit: first legal raw open on a later market session; same-session sale is forbidden
execution_contract.formula: (economic exit proceeds after sell cost)/(14:56 entry VWAP after buy cost)-1
execution_contract.gross_diagnostic: economic exit proceeds before costs / entry VWAP - 1
execution_contract.name: tail_to_first_legal_open_net_return
execution_contract.price_limit_and_suspension: if the next session is suspended or sell_blocked_open, carry without fill to the first later legal open; unknown holding rows fail closed
execution_contract.severe_loss10: minimum cost-aware executable-coordinate low-mark return from entry through exit <= -0.10
execution_contract.signal_timestamp: 14:25:00 after the bar ending 14:25 is complete
